ADVANCEMENT

Ability Dice: mark Growth during play. At 3/3, resolve it in Growth to step the permanent die.

Ability Dots / Core / Techniques: permanent purchases live in the Growth & Acquisitions tab.

QUICK RULES

Ability Check = Ability Die + Core Stat + Ability Dots.

Edge and Negative Edge cancel one-for-one. If one side remains, roll twice and keep the better/worse result.

Technique Uses are the marked pips. Rank is the maximum Uses.

Broken at 0: checks governed by that Track use only the raw Ability Die.

PLAYER ROSTER — ONE SHARED CHARACTER TOKEN POOL
EXPANDING CAST

Swap between recurring cast members without breaking campaign continuity.

The roster acts like your season cast list: keep alternates, duplicates, replacements, and backups organized while preserving the shared token economy.

Roster persists between missionsSwap active character quicklyShared token pool stays fair

Switching saves the current sheet first. Character Tokens remain shared across the player’s roster; replacement and additional characters do not grant another starting pool.
